inherited.M01: Inherited from the three source-study task lineages: Study 1 word repetition, Study 2 rhythmic word repetition, and Study 3 rhythmic syllabic repetition.
inherited.M02: Inherited from the source-study item-label protocols; the paper adds no distinct training-only loss or auxiliary target.
inherited.M03: Inherited from the source cohorts' offline, participant-specific analysis setup; no separate calibration or user–decoder adaptation phase is introduced.
inherited.M04: Inherited from the source-study cued imagine-hearing and imagine-saying actions; the paper evaluates these tasks offline rather than introducing a new user action.
inherited.M07: Inherited from closed-set binary item classification in the source-study analyses; no use-time language model, lexicon, or sequence prior is reported.
inherited.M08: Inherited from the source-study binary item/representation-class endpoint; the system does not generate continuous speech or text.
inherited.M09: Inherited from the noninteractive offline source-study protocol; no user-facing presentation or confirmation stage is reported.
inherited.M10: Inherited from the noninteractive offline source-study protocol; no user correction or re-entry stage is reported.
inherited.M05: Clinical subdural ECoG (plus depth and strips in study 3) in epilepsy patients, placement clinically determined; three legacy datasets (Martin 2016 lineage for study 1).
inherited.M11: Instructed item identity as the label for imagined trials, as in the source studies.
inherited.M13: Offline analysis of short-term clinical epilepsy implants.
